name: Microsoft Azure Data Fundamentals

fee.note: Microsoft prices by exam country/region; the exam page shows the price for your location, before taxes. US price USD 99; USD 59 in Argentina, Mexico, Chile, Colombia, Peru and most of Latin America; EUR 76 in Spain (Microsoft's price list, 2026-11-17). Students and educators can schedule through Certiport.

exam.format: Proctored 45-minute exam through Pearson VUE (Certiport for students and educators); interactive components may appear. Microsoft does not publish the question count or question types per exam.

discounts.text: Academic pricing for students in most countries (not India or China): identify as a student in your Microsoft Learn profile and verify your status before registering.

access.retake: After a failed attempt you wait 24 hours to retake, then 14 days between later attempts, with at most five attempts in 12 months; each retake is paid.
access.accommodations: You can request 30 extra minutes only when the exam is not offered in your preferred language (this one is offered in Spanish); other accommodations are requested through Pearson VUE before you schedule.

scope: Core data concepts, relational and non-relational data on Azure, and analytics workloads on Azure.
ai_policy: Check the current assessment rules. AI-assisted study does not imply permission during the exam.
caveats: Microsoft says most of its exams have 40–60 questions but does not publish the count for DP-900.
